Ashgrove: \(4,390,000\) litres ÷ \(58,760\) residents ÷ \(365\) days = 0.2047 litres per resident per day.

Ashgrove used more, by 0.0048 litres per resident per day, which rounds to 0.0 litres at 1 decimal place.
